summary.text: Pat Roybal Caballero, listed by Ballotpedia as Patricia Roybal Caballero, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 13 who took office on January 1, 2013, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Roybal Caballero earned a B.A. from the University of Colorado at Boulder and dual master's degrees in community and regional planning and public administration from the University of New Mexico.
Her professional experience includes working as a public administrator and as a community and economic developer.
In the 2025-2026 session, Roybal Caballero chairs the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee and serves on the House Education Committee.
